name: Purchased goods and services — spend-based

source.document: Spend-based EEIO average — no specific EEIO model recorded in the code this replaces

note: Provenance not established. EEIO intensities vary by model, region and sector by more than an order of magnitude, so a single global default is a placeholder rather than a factor. Users should override it. Flagged for sourcing.

name: Waste to landfill

source.document: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors — waste disposal

note: The superseded GHG_EF table carried 0.58 tCO2e/t for the same line from the same nominal source. 0.467 is the value that was reaching users and the one the CSV export also hardcoded, so it is recorded here. The disagreement is unresolved — flagged for sourcing.

name: Business travel — air, distance-based

source.document: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors — business travel, air

note: Equals 0.1 kgCO2e/passenger-km. The superseded GHG_EF table carried haul-band factors of 0.151 (short), 0.131 (medium) and 0.195 (long) kgCO2e/pkm, none of which this matches, and none of which were ever used. A single blended factor also discards the haul-band and cabin-class distinctions the source makes. Flagged for sourcing.

name: Employee commuting — working days per year

source.document: Planning assumption, not an emission factor

note: An assumption rather than a factor, registered because it multiplies into the result exactly like one. The superseded GHG_EF table assumed 250 days; the field default of 240 is what reached users.

name: Use of sold products — energy per unit
applies_to: ghg_compute:S3 Cat 11 use of sold products
note: Lifetime energy per unit is product-specific; no general default is defensible. Present so the calculation runs, and combined with the grid factor to produce the result. Users must override it.
